explanation: Updated all 11 planned diagrams from the pinned b08 sources. The trees distinguish generated and supplied edits, atomic batches, retained variants, recorded views, context storage, and native selection/routing ownership. Later branching and presentation alternatives remain explicitly proposed. All trees fit their reserved bounds; the 42/48/44-node budgets, retained attachment labels, and three specified edges validate.
